1973: def log_change(entity_type, entity_id, action, note=""):
1974:     import hashlib, json
1975: 
1976:     try:
1977:         from flask import has_request_context, session
1978:         firm_id = session.get("firm_id", "FIRM-001") if has_request_context() else "FIRM-001"
1979:     except Exception:

1982:     conn = get_connection()
1983:     cur = conn.cursor()
1984: 
1985:     # 1. Get previous hash
1986:     cur.execute("SELECT entry_hash FROM audit_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1")
1987:     row = cur.fetchone()
1988:     previous_hash = row["entry_hash"] if row and row["entry_hash"] else None
1989: 
1990:     # 2. Insert base record WITH firm_id
1991:     cur.execute("""
1992:         INSERT INTO audit_log (entity_type, entity_id, action, note, firm_id)
1993:         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
1994:     """, (entity_type, entity_id, action, note, firm_id))
1995: 
1996:     entry_id = cur.lastrowid
1997: 
1998:     # 3. Get created_at timestamp
1999:     cur.execute("SELECT created_at FROM audit_log WHERE id = ?", (entry_id,))
2000:     created_at = cur.fetchone()["created_at"]
2001: 
2002:     # 4. Build canonical payload
2003:     payload = {
2004:         "id": entry_id,
2005:         "firm_id": firm_id,
2006:         "entity_type": entity_type,
2007:         "entity_id": entity_id,
2008:         "action": action,
2009:         "note": note,
2010:         "created_at": created_at,
2011:         "previous_hash": previous_hash
2012:     }
2013: 
2014:     payload_str = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True)
2015: 
2016:     # 5. Generate hash
2017:     entry_hash = hashlib.sha256(payload_str.encode()).hexdigest()
2018: 
2019:     # 6. Update record with hash values
2020:     cur.execute("""
2021:         UPDATE audit_log
2022:         SET previous_hash = ?, entry_hash = ?, hash_algorithm = ?
2023:         WHERE id = ?
2024:     """, (previous_hash, entry_hash, "sha256", entry_id))
2025: 
2026:     conn.commit()
2027:     conn.close()
